desc:
SOFT BAKED GOODNESS: Nature Valley Maple Nut Soft Baked Bars are a quick and easy breakfast snack, lunch box treat, or for any time you are looking to fuel your family

BREAKFAST BARS: Made with whole grains, almonds, flaxseeds, and chia seeds for a wholesome start to your day; 19g of whole grain per serving (at least 48g recommended daily)

QUALITY INGREDIENTS: No artificial flavors, no artificial colors, and no high fructose corn syrup

GREAT ON THE GO: Hearty-size breakfast bars provide great taste on the go; Toss an individually wrapped bar in a backpack, tote, or school snack bag

CONTAINS: One 8.85 oz box of Nature Valley Maple Nut Soft Baked Breakfast Bars
features:
Key Features:

Soft-Baked Texture

Chewy, moist bars with a muffin-like consistency.

Salted Caramel Flavor

Combines sweet caramel with a hint of salt for a rich, indulgent taste.

Whole Grain Goodness

Contains 12g of whole grains per bar, which supports heart and digestive health.

No Artificial Additives

Made without artificial flavors, colors, or high-fructose corn syrup.

Individually Wrapped

Easy to carry in lunch boxes, backpacks, or purses for on-the-go snacking.

Wholesome Ingredients

Includes oats, almonds, and real caramel flavor.

Benefits:

Quick & Easy Breakfast or Snack

Ideal for busy mornings or midday energy boosts.

Balanced Sweet & Salty Taste

Appeals to a wide variety of taste preferences with its rich flavor and satisfying texture.

Kid- and Family-Friendly

Great for school snacks or as a healthier alternative to dessert.

Portable & Convenient

Perfect for commuting, travel, or outdoor activities like hiking.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Whole Grain Wheat Flour, Sugar, Almonds, Canola and Palm Oil, Vegetable Glycerin, Corn Syrup, Maple Syrup, Chia Seeds, Flaxseeds, Chicory Root Extract, Sugarcane Fiber, Raisin Juice Concentrate, Baking Soda, Molasses, Salt, Egg Whites, Cinnamon, Soy Lecithin, Natural Flavor, Nonfat Milk.
